finalText:
**About 1082 hits in 94 files. Roughly 60 are safe to rename.**

| Zone | Hits | Call |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` app code (78 files) | 1000 | Rename |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `lib/serialize.js` right side | 7 | Freeze. Public contract. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` (5 files) | 20 | Freeze. Generated, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |
| `migrations/*.sql` (12 files) | 61 | Freeze. All applied in production. |

Column stays `account_id` in the DB, so repo SQL strings must keep the old name even when the variable renames. `lib/audit.js` writes an `account_id` key that log queries read.

Next: ask the team if they plan a new dated API version. If not, sign off only on the `services/*` variable rename.
